title: The 49ers-Rams travel question won't be fully resolved until Week 2, or beyond

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The 49ers-Rams travel question won't be fully resolved until Week 2, or beyond
sources.description: Based on Thursday night's smothering down under by the 49ers against the Rams, it appears that San Francisco's early-arrival approach worked better than the Rams' strategy of barnstorming.
